text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio claims victory in the Japanese 
Derby. Twin Turbo, defeated down the long 
final stretch, vows to take her revenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later on, however, it was discovered that 
Tokai Teio had suffered a bone fracture. 
Running in the Kikuka Sho was looking 
grim... but her team announced they 
wouldn't give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All Twin Turbo and the others can do is 
believe in her and get stronger. They keep 
blazing ahead toward autumn.
